comment: * An interface used by LockScreenWidgets to send messages to lock screen.

methods.name: public void requestShow(View self)
methods.comment: on lock screen state. View must be the top-level lock screen widget or it will be ignored.

methods.name: public void requestHide(View self)
methods.comment: Sends a message to lock screen requesting the view to be hidden.

methods.name: public boolean isVisible(View self)
methods.comment: Whether or not this view is currently visible on LockScreen

methods.name: public void userActivity(View self)
methods.comment: exclusively in response to user activity, i.e. user hits a button in the view.
